source_matrix_warning: GEO counts and the published supplement differ. Supplementary beta/FDR are external context, not ground truth for this exploratory estimator.

UBA3.label: Published screen hit
UBA3.published_context: The supplement reports a positive no-IL6 screen effect. This is statistical evidence from the source screen, not independent biological validation.
UBA3.decision_implication: Check guide agreement in the current input and distinguish a count effect from a senescence phenotype before prioritizing this target.
UBA3.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1
UBA3.essentiality_limit: Cancer-cell knockout fitness; not an automatic veto for partial suppression in MSCs. Aggregates count screen rows, not unique cell lines.

SAMM50.label: Published follow-up anchor
SAMM50.published_context: The source paper reports reduced SA-beta-gal after CRISPRi and preserved MSC identity markers, with SAMM50-specific RNA sequencing. These are the authors’ results.
SAMM50.decision_implication: Use as a published comparison anchor; our starting-count filter leaves too few guides for a robust count-based call.
SAMM50.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1
SAMM50.essentiality_limit: Cancer-cell knockout fitness; not an automatic veto for partial suppression in MSCs. Aggregates count screen rows, not unique cell lines.

AK2.label: Published follow-up anchor
AK2.published_context: The source paper reports reduced SA-beta-gal with two independent CRISPRi guides and measures MSC identity markers. These are the authors’ results.
AK2.decision_implication: Use as a published comparison anchor; check guide coverage before drawing a new conclusion.
AK2.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1
AK2.essentiality_limit: Cancer-cell knockout fitness; not an automatic veto for partial suppression in MSCs. Aggregates count screen rows, not unique cell lines.

TP53.label: Strong signal; cell identity concern
TP53.published_context: The paper reports enrichment and altered MSC identity-marker expression after TP53 perturbation, identifying it as unsuitable for their MSC rejuvenation objective.
TP53.decision_implication: Do not equate a strong growth signal with a useful aging intervention; preserved cell identity is a distinct endpoint.
TP53.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1
TP53.essentiality_limit: Not retrieved for this gene; unknown does not mean non-essential.

CDKN1A.label: Known senescence-pathway reference
CDKN1A.published_context: The paper identifies CDKN1A as an enriched pro-senescence reference gene. This is contextual support, not proof that perturbing it safely reverses aging.
CDKN1A.decision_implication: Use as a known pathway reference; require phenotype, fitness and cell-identity evidence before advancing.
CDKN1A.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1
CDKN1A.essentiality_limit: Not retrieved for this gene; unknown does not mean non-essential.

GABRR2.label: Exploratory comparison; limited curated context
GABRR2.published_context: Included because it ranks among the largest positive no-IL6 effects passing our fixed checklist. No gene-specific functional follow-up has been curated in this build.
GABRR2.decision_implication: Review independent biological evidence before treating the count signal as an aging mechanism.
GABRR2.source_location: Results: genome-wide CRISPRi screen and Fig. 1; supplementary Table S1
GABRR2.essentiality_limit: Not retrieved for this gene; unknown does not mean non-essential.

curation_note: Labels and decision_implication are curator summaries. Published findings are in published_context and published_screen_statistics. Guide disagreement and count robustness must be established from the current executed analysis, not inferred from a label.
